build_graph_leo: build the LEO optimization graph with outer model configuration for meta-learning
run_training_loop: run the LEO meta-training loop with checkpointing and early stopping
run_evaluation: run the LEO evaluation-only mode and save metatest accuracy to disk
construct_loss_accuracy: construct loss and accuracy tensors for the LEO model on given inputs
construct_examples_batch: construct a batch of meta-learning examples from train or validation split
